## Design

### 2026-10-12 – First time: Oct 12, 2026

**4h**

First time: Oct 12, 2026

First time making a CAD project. Very confusing icl, but I dont have to use all the tools so I should be fine. So I firstly started with creating the project in onshape.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 162556](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/ff93739070cf6fc6f15ed63808a19ba68a6143637d6972ff0bfccfb9f3bf3081.png)

After that, I started using the guide to create shapes like a rectangle and a circle, I was pretty fun, and then I added some depth to the shapes since the marble race would be 3d, not 2d.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 164336](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/02834daedaf39498447f2d787d7a4e72b75dc4c685e6f6fb16a41ad07d3f7be0.png)

After that, I started using the guide to start creating the tube where the marbles would ride in. I actually had a problem with this because the difference between the inside circle and the outside circle was supposed to be 2.5mm but mines was 0.51213 in. So I fixed that problem by changing the conversions in the project settings. And I used the sweep to create a pretty good looking tube for the marbles.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 165828](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/4ece5e418223113c5aa38983143e5efa78a7ae728cab6f5c58ba5067dddcd980.png)

Now I was working on the more complicated tube, like instead of being straight, it was wavy. But I couldn't make it because the tube for the previous image was overlapping with the new one I was trying to make. So I stopped there, for today, so I can get ready to hopefully get a good amount of it done tomorrow.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 184040](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/2de759f3174e032917d442f28a7a2bc388e961a16e6f336f722126c93726bf75.png)

The squiggle that is coming out of the tube was what I was trying to make into a tube using sweep but I couldn't do it yet. I think if I flip or mirror the plane with the tube on it, I could maybe get it to work.

### 2026-10-13 – CREATED THE CURVED TUBE: Oct 13, 2026

**5h**

CREATED THE CURVED TUBE: Oct 13, 2026

I got the curved tube for the marble run created, I just had to make it again. There were some problems like what did the composite curve even do if the sweep was going to cover it anyways but I was able to make it!

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 155903](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/93b8fb727732d73fbfca149019e0e8f6f92d4a430e70105054f1907febbde5e2.png)

I then started making the plinko thing from the guide and I thought it would look cool in my assembly. So I started with just creating the sketch for the plinko via the guide.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 162941](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/f028bf25af117703d0ede29ee6e4e7b245c26acb75d2ee2e12df12592ded893d.png)

There are a bunch of numbers because I wanted it to be symmetrical. I did have some issues with it like when I added the outer edge, the side triangles started going into the wall but I just trimmed it and fixed it. At the end, the sketch looked like this.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 164833](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/778c25160ac7aa4599db29abd5e71f0e3f2b0449ee68cc03f641ef9f174bdf8d.png)

After this, I started working on actually making it 3d and I made a big mistake because i deleted the stuff inside of the columns so when I went to make it 3d, they were just holes. So I had to go back and add lines inside of each column to give some support and then I was able to 3d make them.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 165844](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/22cc4450f0f8501b83fce9f07287761a08de8739410f7f6638f303b956fa4129.png)

idk why they are rainbow but I created the plinko thing, now the problem I realized was that there was no entrance or exit. So I went back into the sketch and added some separated parts into the gaps. But when I did that, only one of the walls would fill in/ become 3d, so I had to look closer and realized that the right wall wasnt even connected. So I connected it and added the entrance and exit so now it looks like this.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 170654](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/b3ca15ee2eabba206395eeffeb17a0dbcac59ad797ce4736d74e0114473c000a.png)

Now I will start working on the funnel because a marble run is incomplete without one, and maybe some other stuff that I come up with.

### 2026-10-14 – NEW ADDITIONS: Oct 14, 2026

**2h**

NEW ADDITIONS: Oct 14, 2026

Today I worked on just creating some additions and fixing of the parts, Firstly, I realized that the plinko mechine thing was actually kinda weird, because if a ball just followed the wall, it wouldn't be able to go through the exit. So I sloped the exit of the plinko part so even the balls that follow the wall can get out. The sloping took more time than I care to admit simply because I didn't know there was a extend feature, that would have saved me time before. But I found that and was able to create the slope in the plinko thing.

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 172520](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/79d0ca042777693152b1e664dccc003bae36d5a52982868dd9e85a4205f6e728.png)

You can see the slight slope on the bottom, I didnt slope it too much because then the ball that would land on the side would be able to get a lot more speed than the ones that were centered. After that, I started working on the funnel from my previous entry, and I finished it! It wasn't that difficult to make so I didn't take too much time on it.

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 174952](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/a10d5fea1185803e7a57e6f0a306f6084764b9316896f156477a873af420d94e.png)

It ended up looking like this, A previous one looked alot more blocky but then I spliced the edges and made the funnel more circular. Next I want to start making like a slope staircase thing and any other ideas I might come up with. If I don't come up with any more ideas then i'll just start on the assembly.

### 2026-10-15 – I started working on the central piece that will hold the entire structure up. It was pretty much the same process as making the tube at the beginning without the inner piece. After that, I wanted to

**2h**

I started working on the central piece that will hold the entire structure up. It was pretty much the same process as making the tube at the beginning without the inner piece. After that, I wanted to add two holes one either side so the balls/marbles could start at the same time.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 181254](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/1033d7b0ca186812d251903a03d41393cf80158d99ec1ddfb772769ddfc52042.png)

I made this tube coming out of it but the problem was that there was no hole made, so the ball would get stuck. So I searched up on google/ help from gemini, to find out that extrude can also remove stuff. So I tried doing it but it didn't work.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 182646](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/9c6ce7ab384c414b890b745ab910489207a29f29cf0eb0eed0b9a220f4c2c51b.png)

After that, I was going to start assembly of the marble run but found that the plinko part that I made had like 30 parts instead on being one part. So I went back to the plinko thing and used the Union tool to unionize the part. This also got rid of the rainbow parts that the plinko had so now its just full grey

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 182902](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/55c36af9d18f21c14a20f7ac6e48e4a8e5a2ca4aff30632941d7008cc95c8b61.png)

Tomorrow, I will start to assemble the marble run race.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 183010](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/a4ce68116fb5ab736caebc9ea6d9f64c400d5785bab3b0357bcdd7a61476542d.png)

These are all the parts that I made that are inside the assembly.

### 2026-10-16 – LAST TIME, oct 16, 2026

**1.5h**

LAST TIME, oct 16, 2026

I think I might be done, It doesnt look the best because I don't have time to work on this anymore. I have just used the parts that I made and created a marble run which is one sided.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 190103](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/e09505dc33f669398d95ef63a039023d5d2b82680925cc03f1e36a835b31b55c.png)

This is how it looks from the front, usually I would have no problem continuing building but I dont want to make like 20 parts that are the same, just different angles. It seems very time-consuming and useless to make something like that.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 190113](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FrwjC1X5XOInayrnpPDTeLMtHsB5eUED/66098348fe83bf215da4f259f1de96b3fbfdadfa69906b4bd322a44431f6e83d.png)

This is the side view. You can see that the tube is angled towards the edge of the funnel so the marbles can roll a bunch in the funnel before going into the plinko machine. Before the marble goes into the funnel, it actually goes through a curving tube which would slow it down a bit so there can be some competition in the funnel. Other than that, I think I have finished Week 2 of half life!
